title: storage: create TranscriptStore trait
description: Define the TranscriptStore trait that abstracts transcript persistence operations for the Progressive Discover system. This trait will serve as the core interface for storing, retrieving, and managing conversation transcripts with support for incremental updates and atomic operations.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a TranscriptStore trait for all storage implementations
THE SYSTEM SHALL support async operations for non-blocking I/O

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a transcript needs to be persisted
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a save method that atomically writes the transcript to storage

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a transcript needs to be loaded
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a load method that retrieves the transcript by its unique identifier

unwanted.condition: IF the storage backend is unavailable
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently fail or corrupt data
unwanted.because: data integrity is critical for conversation continuity

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow race conditions that result in partial or inconsistent writes
unwanted.because: transcripts must maintain consistency across all operations

preconditions: The TranscriptStore trait must be defined in the storage module
All trait methods must be async and return Result types
Transcript type must already be defined with serialization support
postconditions: The trait provides save, load, delete, and list operations
All methods return appropriate error types for failure handling
The trait is object-safe allowing for dynamic dispatch
invariants: Each transcript has a unique identifier that never changes
Transcript ordering is preserved when listing

happy: Verify trait compiles with a mock implementation
Verify save method signature accepts Transcript and returns Result<TranscriptId, Error>
Verify load method signature accepts TranscriptId and returns Result<Transcript, Error>
Verify delete method signature accepts TranscriptId and returns Result<(), Error>
error: Verify trait methods return appropriate error types for storage failures
Verify trait handles missing transcripts with dedicated error variant
Verify trait methods propagate errors from underlying storage backend

phase_0: Review existing trait patterns in Rust for async storage
phase_2: Define TranscriptStore trait with save, load, delete, list methods

similar: See existing storage traits in clarity-web/src/storage/
